card.fact_statement: Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner signed the Washington Peace Accords as the foreign minister of the DRC.
card.source_span: signed by the foreign ministers of the DRC and Rwanda, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner and Olivier Nduhungirehe

target_qa_variants.question: ¿Qué figura clave firmó los Acuerdos de Paz de Washington en su calidad de ministro de Relaciones Exteriores de la RDC?
target_qa_variants.source_span: signed by the foreign ministers of the DRC and Rwanda, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner and Olivier Nduhungirehe
target_qa_variants.translation_note: RDC is the standard Spanish abbreviation for DRC (República Democrática del Congo). 'Ministro de Relaciones Exteriores' is the standard translation for foreign minister.

backtranslation_en.question: What key figure signed the Washington Peace Agreements in their capacity as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the DRC?
